$comment: NB 2.1 art spec for the Coin Cosmetics Boutique sleeves. Paint with: node art/wavespeed.mjs boutique-sleeve --backend gemini
lead: Paint the back of a fantasy trading card, portrait orientation, filling edge to edge.
style: Symmetrical ornamental card-back painting in oil and gouache with crisp hand-painted filigree and rich lacquered pigments.
rules: Paint the BACK of a playing card: a symmetrical ornamental design (looks right-side-up from both top and bottom) with a central emblem framed by a painted border; no text, no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering.

items.subject: symmetrical marble-and-sapphire geometric filigree card back with interlocking white-gold scales and soaring bird-wing arches
symmetrical crimson velvet and wrought-iron scrollwork card back with stylized flame motifs and burnished bronze diamonds
symmetrical deep moss-green and dark slate botanical card back with woven fern fronds, mushrooms and carved stone knots
symmetrical cobalt-and-copper artificer coil card back with sweeping brass arcs, balanced lightning filaments and enamel panels
symmetrical overlapping burnished crimson-and-bronze dragon scales framed by dark forged iron filigree
symmetrical midnight-blue astronomical astrolabe card back with fine gold-leaf rings, crescent moons and compass stars
